applicability: Part 3D Inland Code (cl 3D.1(1)): applies on land in Zones RU1, RU2, RU3, RU4, RU5, RU6, R1, R2, R3, R4 and R5 in inland local government areas (69 LGAs incl. Balranald, Cabonne, Cobar, Gwydir, Hay, Liverpool Plains, Warren, Carrathool); Housing Code and Rural Housing Code do not apply there except as cl 3D.2 provides.
